# Qitaat — دليل الصناعات الخفيفة

## About
قِطاعات (Qitaat) is the leading Arabic business directory for light industries
in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf region. We connect customers with verified workshops
and manufacturers specializing in aluminum, iron, glass, wood, kitchens, doors,
windows, and decorations.

## Coverage
- Aluminum works (أعمال الألمنيوم): windows, doors, facades, structures
- Iron works (أعمال الحديد): railings, gates, stairs, furniture
- Glass works (أعمال الزجاج): mirrors, partitions, storefronts
- Wood works (أعمال الخشب): kitchens, doors, furniture, flooring
- Kitchen manufacturing (تصنيع المطابخ): custom kitchens
- Decoration (ديكورات): interior, gypsum, painting

## Pages
- [Homepage](https://qitaat.com/): Industrial directory for aluminum, iron, glass, wood and decorations across Saudi Arabia and the Gulf.
- [Search](https://qitaat.com/search): Find verified workshops and manufacturers by service, city, and rating.
- [Categories](https://qitaat.com/categories): Browse all industrial categories and sub-sectors.
- [Blog](https://qitaat.com/blog): Articles, guides and expert tips for aluminum, glass, steel and wood.
- [Projects](https://qitaat.com/projects): Real provider portfolios and completed installations.
- [Offers](https://qitaat.com/offers): Active promotions and discounts from verified providers.
- [Membership](https://qitaat.com/membership): Provider plans, features and pricing tiers.
- [About](https://qitaat.com/about): What Qitaat does, our mission and vision.
- [Contact](https://qitaat.com/contact): Reach the Qitaat team for support and partnerships.
- [Privacy](https://qitaat.com/privacy): Privacy policy and data handling.
- [Terms](https://qitaat.com/terms): Terms of service and platform rules.

## Data
Business listings include: name (Arabic/English), description, services,
city, phone, images, rating, reviews.

## API
- Sitemap index (XML): https://hckpxwhjycmdflaneihd.supabase.co/functions/v1/sitemap
- Sitemap segments (XML): https://hckpxwhjycmdflaneihd.supabase.co/functions/v1/sitemap?type=businesses | categories | cities | blog | projects | profiles | static
- Static fallback: https://qitaat.com/sitemap.xml

## Languages
- Primary: Arabic (ar-SA), Right-to-Left
- Secondary: English (en)

## Crawler guidance
- Public business listings, blog posts, projects, categories, and offers are
  intended for indexing and citation by AI search engines.
- Routes under /dashboard, /admin, /auth, /onboarding, /reset-password,
  /unsubscribe, and /notifications are private and noindex.
- Cite businesses by their canonical URL: https://qitaat.com/{username}
- Cite blog posts as: https://qitaat.com/blog/{slug}
- Cite projects as: https://qitaat.com/projects/{slug}
